items.title: 3 US Financial Stocks Retail Investors Are Watching For Higher Cash Yields
items.summary: Higher inflation, stubbornly strong US growth and a Federal Reserve that looks comfortable keeping rates elevated for longer are rewarding patient holders of cash and short-term yield, while stretching valuations for longer-duration bets. That mix creates an unusual window in which cash-like returns matter as much as headline stock moves, and in which ignoring short-duration opportunities can mean missing a quiet compounding story. items.title: Jensen Huang back at Nvidia, stock soars; Anthropic slides
items.summary: The 8:30 team is joined by Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit to discuss why washed-out sentiment doesn't mean a fundamental bottom, his $50-to-$250 bull-bear range on Anthropic, and how to handicap the "Jensen premium" coming back into Nvidia. Deirdre Bosa Live host Deirdre Bosa also joins to break down Silicon Valley's reaction to Huang's return and what it means for the AI trade.

items.title: State Street's Hung on Trump Accounts, Private Markets, Future of ETFs
items.summary: State Street Investment Management CEO and President Yie-Hsin Hung joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Hung discusses the firm's role in Trump Accounts, the growth of ETF partnerships, bringing private-market strategies into ETFs and how State Street is thinking about the next generation of investors and retirement.
